title: ZFP36-ferroptosis axis as a key renal protective pathway in diabetic kidney disease.
authors: Li, Anni; Ye, Yuxuan; Cao, Huimin; Hu, Jiawei; Shi, Min; Zhang, Juan; Zhang, Yiyuan; Liu, Yuting; Gu, Bixia; Zhang, Hong
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦糖尿病肾病中RNA结合蛋白ZFP36调控铁死亡，虽含分子对接但对象为RNA-蛋白及小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD) is strongly related to ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of programmed cell death characterized by the accumulation of lipid peroxides. While ferroptosis is a pivotal mediator in DKD pathogenesis, its upstream regulatory mechanism remains poorly defined, thus impeding the development of targeted therapeutic strategies. In this study, by integrating multi-omics clinical data (GSE96804 and GSE104954) and combining machine learning algorithms, the RNA-binding protein ZFP36 was screened out as the core regulatory factor of ferroptosis in DKD. The results revealed that the expression level of ZFP36 in the DKD group was significantly lower than that in the normal group. Functional experiments demonstrated that overexpression of ZFP36 could significantly alleviate lipid peroxidation, iron ion accumulation, and cellular fibrosis, thereby inhibiting ferroptosis and alleviating kidney damage. Transcriptome analysis further revealed that ZFP36 regulated key genes related to oxidative stress and iron metabolism. Additionally, molecular docking simulations revealed strong binding affinity between ZFP36 and bioactive natural products such as berberine and astragalus, providing a potential mechanism for its renal protective effect. Overall, ZFP36 was hereby established as an important inhibitor of ferroptosis in DKD, highlighting its potential as both a biomarker and a therapeutic target for its precision diagnosis and intervention.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（Diabetic Kidney Disease, DKD）与铁死亡（ferroptosis）密切相关，铁死亡是一种铁依赖性的程序性细胞死亡形式，其特征是脂质过氧化物的积累。尽管铁死亡在DKD发病机制中起关键介导作用，但其上游调控机制仍不明确，从而阻碍了靶向治疗策略的开发。在本研究中，通过整合多组学临床数据（GSE96804和GSE104954）并结合机器学习算法，RNA结合蛋白ZFP36被筛选为DKD中铁死亡的核心调控因子。结果显示，DKD组中ZFP36的表达水平显著低于正常组。功能实验表明，ZFP36的过表达能显著减轻脂质过氧化、铁离子积累和细胞纤维化，从而抑制铁死亡并缓解肾脏损伤。转录组分析进一步揭示，ZFP36调控了与氧化应激和铁代谢相关的关键基因。此外，分子对接模拟显示ZFP36与生物活性天然产物如小檗碱（berberine）和黄芪（astragalus）之间具有强结合亲和力，为其肾脏保护作用提供了潜在机制。总体而言，ZFP36在此被确立为DKD中铁死亡的重要抑制剂，凸显其作为生物标志物和治疗靶点在精准诊断和干预中的潜力。
